camel_example: aliyun pvtz UpdateZoneRecord --region cn-hangzhou --Rr www --Type A --Value '192.16.XX.XX' --RecordId 1722230000
description_en: The UpdateZoneRecord operation modifies a DNS record for a zone. You can change properties such as the host record, record type, and weight
description_zh: 调用UpdateZoneRecord修改域名（Zone）的解析记录，包括主机记录、解析记录、权重等
kebab_example: aliyun pvtz update-zone-record --rr www --record-id 1722230000 --type A --value 192.16.XX.XX --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateZoneRecord

parameters.help_en:
The host record. This is the prefix of a domain name. Common examples include www, @, * (for wildcard DNS), and mail (for mailboxes).

For example, to resolve @.example.com, set the host record to "@", not an empty string
parameters.help_zh:
主机记录。主机记录就是域名前缀，常见用法有www、@、*（泛解析）、mail（常用于邮箱）

例如要解析@.exmaple.com，主机记录要填写"@”，而不是空
parameters.name: rr

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.

en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh：中文。

en：英文。

默认值：en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DNS record. To obtain the ID, call the DescribeZoneRecords operation to query a list of DNS records
parameters.help_zh: 解析记录ID。可以通过调用DescribeZoneRecords查询解析记录列表获取
parameters.name: record_id

parameters.help_en: The DNS resolution line. The default value is default
parameters.name: line

parameters.help_en: The weight of the record. Valid values are integers from 1 to 100. The default value is 1. You can set different weights for records to return IP addresses in proportion to their weights
parameters.help_zh: 权重值（1-100 内的整数，包括 1 和 100，默认为1），支持对每个地址设置不同的权重值，实现解析查询按照权重比例返回地址
parameters.name: weight

parameters.help_en:
The type of the DNS record. The following types are supported:

A: Maps a domain name to an IPv4 address in dotted decimal notation.

AAAA: Maps a domain name to an IPv6 address.

CNAME: Maps a domain name to another domain name.

TXT: A text record. The text can be up to 255 characters in length. TXT records are often used for Sender Policy Framework (SPF) records to prevent spam.

MX: Maps a domain name to the domain name of a mail server.

PTR: Maps an IP address to a domain name.

SRV: A service record that specifies the server for a specific service. The format is: Priority Weight Port Target. Each part must be separated by a space.

Before adding a PTR record, configure a reverse lookup zone. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2592976.html
parameters.help_zh:
解析记录类型，目前支持如下：
A：将域名指向一个IPV4（点分十进制格式的IPv4地址）。
AAAA：将域名指向一个IPV6（IPv6地址）。
CNAME：将域名指向另一个域名（域名地址）。
TXT：文本长度限制255，通常做SPF记录（反垃圾邮件）。
MX：将域名指向邮件服务器地址（邮件服务器的域名）。
PTR：将IP地址指向一个域名。
SRV：记录提供特定的服务的服务器（格式为 优先级 权重 端口 目标地址，每项中间需以空格分隔）。
添加PTR记录前需要先配置反解Zone，具体操作请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2592976.html
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The time to live (TTL) in seconds (s). Valid values: 5, 30, 60, 3600 (1 hour), 43200 (12 hours), and 86400 (1 day)
parameters.name: ttl

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the MX record. You can set different priorities for mail servers. Valid values: 1 to 99. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

This parameter is required if the record type is MX
parameters.help_zh:
MX记录的优先级。可以为不同邮件服务器设置优先级，优先级取值 1-99，取值越小，优先级越高。
记录类型为MX记录时，此参数必选
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en: The record value. Enter a value that corresponds to the record type
parameters.help_zh: 记录值。根据不同解析记录类型，填写相应的记录值
parameters.name: value

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the client
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates the value, which must be unique among different requests. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

RecordId.description_en: The ID of the DNS record

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request
